# P1 Canonical Alignment — §4 Psychoid Flowering

**Wave:** T13 / #14.  
**Movements:** 31–36.  
**Canonical routing authority:** `working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/P1-48-MOVEMENT-CANONICAL-PROPAGATION.md`.

## Section burden after T09

§4 carries the psychoid, image and individuation field without treating analogy as proof. [A19](../arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md)/[A20](../arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md)/[A21](../arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) supply the psychic argument: complex as local arbitration regime, image/valuation/possession, and individuation/recognition. [A18](../arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md)/[C61](../arguments/concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture.md) keep formal/mythemic/epistemic registers connected without collapsing them. [A26](../arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md)/[A33](../arguments/A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) enter at the end as the return from psychic/worldhood questions into technically inspectable model-internal fields.

Psychoid Number remains **disciplined cross-domain research**, not numerological confirmation of QL. Jung/Pauli, Gebser, Lacan and the Mythemes retain source-specific standing. The agent-subjectivity proof boundary remains active: performed subjectivity, Objective Internality, functional agency, recursive self-description and phenomenality are distinct.

## Release

§4 releases into §5 with a question precise enough for engineering: which distinctions can be made inspectable and experimentally consequential without pretending that inspectability has located or disproved a phenomenal Subject?
